name: warsmash-web-src
description: Astro+Preact frontend for the Warsmash HTML5 port. Builds the public site (landing, multiplayer pages, engine page, asset manager) from src/. Output goes to ./dist via `npm run build`; the gradle :html:buildWebSrc task copies that into html/build/dist/webapp/. The TeaVM-compiled engine (engine-worker.js, app.js) is layered on top by other gradle tasks.
